name: CWG Plc
source: FY2025 (year ended 31 December 2025, audited) added from CWG Plc consolidated and separate financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025, NGX filing library, doclib.ngxgroup.com, file 46316_CWG_PLC QUARTER_5 FINANCIAL STATEMENT FOR 2025, approved by the board on 18 March 2026. Group column, thousands of naira multiplied by 1000. The issuer printed: revenue 65,558,198, cost of sales (49,617,667), gross profit 15,940,531, other income 598,085, administrative expenses (8,414,244), exchange loss (605,223), operating profit 7,519,149, finance costs (61,102), finance income 421,214, profit before tax 7,879,261, income tax (2,904,158), profit after taxation 4,975,103 and earnings per share 1.97 kobo. Revenue minus cost of sales equals gross profit and profit before tax minus income tax equals net profit, both exactly. Net Finance Costs is finance costs less finance income, a net income in the year. The ratio rows are recomputed from this statement and the period end balance sheet printed in the same document (total equity 8,921,127, total assets 39,953,204, total liabilities 31,032,077). Issuer website confirms the same headline figures. | H1 2026 (period ended 30 June 2026, unaudited) added from CWG Plc condensed interim financial statements (NGX doclib); N'000 x1000. Group column. | CWG Plc audited consolidated financial statements FY2024 (NGX doclib) | rows completed from the issuer's printed FINANCIAL SUMMARY - GROUP | FILL 20261007: basic earnings per share for the half year ended 30 June 2026 derived from the issuer interim, which prints profit for the period of 3,645,643 thousand naira and 2,524,826,359 ordinary shares of 50 kobo each (note 15, share capital). 3,645,643,000 divided by 2,524,826,359 equals 1.4439 naira. The interim does not print an earnings per share line. Source: https://doclib.ngxgroup.com/Financial_NewsDocs/47704_CWG_PLC-_QUARTER_2_-_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_FOR_2026_FINANCIAL_STATEMENTS_JULY_2026.pdf
